policy: Quote-first exact immutable source IDs and fixed neutral question IDs. Integrity is mechanical only; relevance, semantic coverage, omissions, component/variant scope, completeness, authenticity and truth unverified. No buying verdicts. Full immutable seller listing visible. Malformed/unsupported output has empty suggestions. Model contract frozen before any v3 inference and before parent fresh six cases arrive. Historical exposed cases are not fresh evaluation.
note: The dynamic request schema enumerates eligible IDs for each exact description; its implementation and bounds are pinned by module hash. Example schema hashes are reproducibility aids, not an enumeration of all possible seller inputs.
